tines: Building the Prongs of Your Forking Paths

Source: R/tines-package.R
tines-package.Rd

Tools for documenting analytical decisions in data analysis. Analytical decisions are documented as a schema of steps, and large language models are used to generate and validate R code. Schemas can be expanded with alternative decisions into a multiverse of analyses, allowing analysts to explore how their conclusions depend on the analytical choices they made.
